items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: The interviewee discusses a different musician named Roosevelt (Tampa Red/Hudson Whittaker) and mentions 'Roosevelt Sykes' only in the interviewer's question as the source of information about another person ('Roosevelt Sykes told me about it'). The interviewee does not claim a personal relationship

ctx.x: He named Roosevelt, I think. Roosevelt? He named Roosevelt, I think. Roosevelt?

Or Martin? Yeah, he named him. I think it was a couple of good harmonica. Down on the south side of Chicago, remember? That's too late, you know. Of course there was little Walter, but those fellows came up after you left. Yeah, this guy's named Roosevelt. I can't think his first name. We'll try to find out who it is someday.
